sentence: This project studies which implants and surgical approaches work best for individual patients having joint arthroplasty surgery.
This project builds virus mutants and makes viral stocks, and processes samples from rhesus macaques in virus challenge experiments.
This project helps researchers make and study genetically modified mice, including transgenic and knockout mice, for cancer studies.
This project studies how the ends of messenger RNA expand, what controls this, and how it affects translation during metabolic changes.
This project builds and tests mobile digital biomarkers that use photoplethysmography to spot peripheral artery disease and coronary artery disease early.
This project studies a reactive state of astrocytes seen in white matter degeneration and how it shapes repair-related microglia.
This project studies what a gene linked to congenital heart disease does in the cell types that form the heart, using mouse model systems.
This project studies how Candida auris gains and keeps mutations that make it resistant to fluconazole.
This project compares failure risk of leads for pacemakers and implantable cardioverter-defibrillators and builds a system to predict which implanted leads may fail early.
This project builds deep learning models and open-source software that use single-cell data to study how cells control transcription.
This project studies how diabetes changes alternative splicing in the proximal tubule of the kidney and how this leads to kidney fibrosis.
This project collects, grows and stores airway epithelial cells and smooth muscle cells from biopsies of people with severe asthma and healthy control subjects.
This project tests whether repeated MRI scans of the brain and cervical cord can track disease progression in clinical trials.
This project studies how two cell-adhesion molecules contribute to synaptogenesis, a process linked to disorders such as autism.
This project studies how people are exposed to harmful things in water, air and emerging threats, to reduce chronic disease risks in rural communities.
This project builds and tests enhancers that target specific types of noradrenergic, serotonergic, cholinergic and dopaminergic neurons.
This project builds and tests a way to load extracellular vesicles with genome editors and checks their quality for gene therapy.
This project checks how well gene editing tools change target DNA and unwanted DNA in animal tissue, and improves base editing.
This project studies how shape changes in the outer part of a receptor tyrosine kinase control its kinase activity inside cells and its signaling.
This project studies how human antibodies protect against encephalitic alphaviruses such as Eastern equine encephalitis virus, including antibodies engineered to reach the brain.
